label: Fly.io

sensitivePaths.label: Create a machine
sensitivePaths.warning: It is billed as long as it exists.

agentGuide: Machines API, base path /v1; most calls need ?org_slug=personal (or your org) on the apps list. Apps: GET /v1/apps?org_slug=personal; one: GET /v1/apps/<app>. Machines: GET /v1/apps/<app>/machines (id, name, state, region, config.image); one: GET /v1/apps/<app>/machines/<id>; start, stop, restart: POST /v1/apps/<app>/machines/<id>/start (stop, restart); signal: POST .../signal {"signal": "SIGTERM"}. Create: POST /v1/apps/<app>/machines {"name": "...", "region": "cdg", "config": {"image": "...", "guest": {"cpu_kind": "shared", "cpus": 1, "memory_mb": 256}}}. Volumes: GET /v1/apps/<app>/volumes. Secrets names: GET /v1/apps/<app>/secrets. Logs are not in this API (use `fly logs` or the dashboard). The token is set by Allkin.
